{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2022–23 |team=San Diego Toreros |sport=Basketball |image=San Diego Toreros logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=West Coast Conference |division= |short_conf= WCC |APRank= |CoachRank= |record= 11–20 |conf_record= 4–12 |head_coach=[[Steve Lavin]] |hc_year = 1st |asst_coach1=John Moore |asst_coach2=[[Tyus Edney]] |asst_coach3=Patrick Sandle |stadium=[[Jenny Craig Pavilion]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of San Diego]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Toreros were led by first-year head coach [[Steve Lavin]] They played their home games at the [[Jenny Craig Pavilion]] in [[San Diego|San Diego, California]], as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team|Toreros]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 15–16, 7–9 in [[2021–22 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]] to finish in seventh place.{{Cite web |title=2021-22 San Diego Toreros Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/san-diego/2022-schedule.html |access-date=2022-04-20 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} They defeated [[2021–22 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Pepperdine]] in the first round of the [[2022 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]] in the second round.{{Cite web |title=San Diego vs. Portland - Game Recap - March 4, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401403486 |access-date=2022-04-20 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Offseason== On March 6, 2022, the school fired head coach [[Sam Scholl]].{{Cite web |date=2022-03-06 |title=USD fires basketball coach Sam Scholl after four seasons |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/toreros/story/2022-03-06/usd-fires-basketball-coach-sam-scholl-after-four-seasons |access-date=2022-03-29 |website=San Diego Union-Tribune |language=en-US}} On April 8, the school hired former [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]] and [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's]] head coach Steve Lavin as the team's new head coach.{{Cite web |date=April 8, 2022 |title=Former UCLA head coach Steve Lavin hired to lead USD men's basketball team |url=https://www.cbs8.com/article/sports/basketball/university-of-san-diego-hires-steve-lavin/509-10bba7fa-307d-4bfe-b37d-298ec24b1801 |access-date=2022-04-20 |website=cbs8.com |language=en-US}} Lavin had not coached since [[2014–15 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|2015]].{{Cite web |date=2022-04-07 |title=Lavin returns to coaching at struggling San Diego |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33687628/steve-lavin-hired-san-diego-men-basketball-coach |access-date=2022-04-20 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
